title: AGEL Board Meeting
agenda: 1. Take note of the Minutes of the previous audit committee meeting held on 25th July and 28th July
2. Take note of action taken on decisions of the previous audit committee meeting
3. Review matters pursuant to Regulation 18(3) of SEBI LODR
4. Review inter corporate loans and investments made by the company during the quarter
5. Review investment made by unlisted subsidiary during the quarter ended September
6. Review compliance with provisions of SEBI insider trading regulation
7. Review status of vigil mechanism for the quarter ended 30th September
8. Review internal audit report for the quarter ended 30th September
decisions: Minutes of the previous audit committee meeting were finalised and entered in the minute book
Omnibus approval accorded to additional RPTs to be entered into during the financial year
Financial results for the first quarter were approved and submitted to stock exchanges
No differential points requiring note under Regulation 18(3) of SEBI LODR
No specific investments were made by AGEL during the quarter other than those stated
Investments amounting to about 784 crore rupees were made into step down subsidiaries
Compliance with SEBI insider trading regulations confirmed with no deviations
No complaints reported under the vigil mechanism during the quarter
Internal audit report for the quarter was reviewed and positive progress noted
